description: This file defines the App class for a WPF application in the Focalboard project, handling application startup, single-instance enforcement, server initialization, and interop with native DLLs.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class managing startup, single-instance check, server initialization, and window focus.

classes.name: GoFunctions
classes.description: Static class providing P/Invoke signatures for starting and stopping the native server.

methods.name: SingleInstanceCheck
methods.description: Ensures only one instance of the application runs, bringing existing window to foreground if another instance is detected.

methods.name: ShowExistingWindow
methods.description: Finds and activates the existing application window.

methods.name: App_Startup
methods.description: Handles application startup event, initializes server, and manages exceptions.

methods.name: InitServer
methods.description: Sets up server port, session token, directories, and starts the native server DLL.

methods.name: CreateSessionToken
methods.description: Generates a secure random session token encoded in Base64.

methods.name: FindFreePort
methods.description: Finds an available TCP port for server binding.
